thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: streaming-model-int8 p99 latency breach detected (> 1200ms) across us-west-2. alert_id=INC-45123, severity=page

erin-oncall: picking this up. oncall Erin here — pulling metrics and logs now. which customers hit this?

sam-ml: seeing a big spike correlated with the int8 quant profile toggle from last night. p50 ~ 200ms, p95 ~ 900ms, p99 ~ 1800-2200ms for streaming routes.

maria-sre: confirmed; traces show long queuing in kv-cache dequant stage, lots of grpc retries from runtime nodes. attaching quick log snippet:

```
2024-04-03T02:05:12Z [runtime-34] WARN kv-dequant: backlog=312 latency_ms=1450 model=streaming-model-int8 shard=gpu-07
2024-04-03T02:05:13Z [runtime-21] ERROR stream-send: client_rtt=1200 token_emit=5 err=timeout
```

erin-oncall: thanks. initial plan: reduce traffic to int8 variant, route to fp16 fallback, and enable reduced-batch mode for streaming to avoid long tails. Rafael, can you push the routing override?

rafael-eng: on it. running emergency route change:

```
# control plane call
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/route/override \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_OPS" \
  -d '{"target":"streaming-model-fp16","weight":0.8,"scope":"us-west-2"}'
```

rafael-eng: override applied. int8 traffic weight set to 20% for us-west-2. confirming metrics...

incident-bot: ROUTE_CHANGE: override applied by rafael-eng at 1712350120.

sam-ml: immediate improvement on p99 down to ~700ms on fallback. p95 ~ 350ms. tail still elevated for the remaining int8 shard traffic.

maria-sre: also toggled runtime flag to reduce max_batch_size to 8 for streaming-model-int8:

```
# runtime flag
PUT /runtime/configs/streaming-model-int8 { "max_batch_size": 8 }
```

maria-sre: that dropped queuing depth on the hot shard, p99 further reduced to ~550ms for fallback path.

erin-oncall: good. logging customer impact: cs-lead-anika, can you confirm which accounts saw errors/latency? need to notify if any SLA risk.

cs-lead-anika: two customers with high volume (acct-A, acct-B) reported degraded latency and a few 504s during the spike window 02:03–02:10 UTC. CS has opened support tickets and alerted their eng contacts. no billing/ingress anomalies.

rafael-eng: root cause hypothesis: the int8 profile we pushed had an aggressive dequant caching optimization that interacts poorly with streaming kv-cache under certain sequence-length distributions. appears to increase CPU dequant work causing stalls and queueing.

sam-ml: added: the profile included a new fused-dequant path that bypasses a short-circuit for long sequences; it reduces avg token cost but under high variance it creates blocking that balloons tail latency.

erin-oncall: action items for live: 1) keep override (80% to fp16) 2) scale up a couple of fp16 instances in us-west-2 for capacity 3) revert the fused-dequant flag on int8 for now 4) CS notifications sent 5) collect traces + example requests for postmortem.

rafael-eng: scaling fp16 now: autoscale override + spin up 4 extra nodes.

deploy-bot: SCALE_EVENT: requested 4 fp16 nodes in us-west-2; started at 1712350208.

maria-sre: starting revert of fused-dequant on int8 profile:

```
PATCH /models/streaming-model/int8/profiles/current { "flags": { "fused_dequant": false } }
```

maria-sre: revert applied at 1712350350. watching.

incident-bot: METRIC_UPDATE: p99 streaming endpoints in us-west-2 now 420ms (rolling 5m) as of 1712350600.

erin-oncall: excellent. moving to containment->investigation. I'm going to start a short-freq pager silence for non-critical alerts to reduce noise while we stabilize.

sam-ml: collecting a sample set of requests that hit the fused-dequant path to reproduce locally. if we can get a deterministic replay that'll help patching.

anika: CS updated customers and offered rollback window; both accounts asked to be notified when fully normalized.

rafael-eng: note: this is not a capacity CPU limit — it's a code-path contention issue in the dequant microkernel when mixed-seq workloads hit the same vGPU. Will open a ticket to mark the profile as blocked for rollout until we validate under mixed loads.

erin-oncall: handoff plan: I'm oncall for next 30m, then maria-sre will take primary until 06:00 UTC. leaving a running checklist in the incident board. please add any follow-ups to INC-45123.

maria-sre: acknowledged. I'll keep the route override in place and coordinate with infra to run load tests against the int8 profile in a canary cluster before we re-enable.

sam-ml: quick note for postmortem: capture prompt-length distribution, request concurrency, and the exact profile flags. also check kernel version differences between shards.

erin-oncall: customer impact: transient increased latency for two high-volume accounts, some 5xxs during the peak. no data loss. SLAs will be reviewed with CS.

rafael-eng: I'll mark the int8 profile as 'blocked' in the model catalog and add a rollback audit.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity downgraded to mitigated at 1712351800. next: postmortem and mitigation follow-ups assigned.

erin-oncall: thanks everyone. final notes: ticket INC-45123 assigned to sam-ml (root cause), rafael-eng (routing & catalog), maria-sre (runtime mitigation), anika (customer comms). I'll file a short timeline and schedule a 1hr postmortem tomorrow.

cs-lead-anika: I'll follow up with the two customers and share the timeline.

maria-sre: handing off to oncall shift lead for long tail monitoring — leaving override active until we validate canary. please escalate if p99 > 700ms again.

erin-oncall: handing off. last check: p99 at 380ms, errors normal. handing to maria-sre at 1712353200.

maria-sre: taking over. I'll update the incident doc and kick off the canary tests.

sam-ml: adding reproduction notes and the request capture to INC-45123. will propose a safer rollout gating matrix for quant profiles (sequence-length-aware smoke tests).

rafael-eng: adding routing playbook step to the runbook: automatic partial-weight rollback when p99 breach + streaming tail detected.

incident-bot: THREAD CLOSED: mitigation in progress; postmortem scheduled.
